messages:
sam: @priya @mike heads up — SOC2 auditor asked for access logs + repro for last week's API 503 spike. attaching timeline, need quick answers on retention window and key material proof. linking incident bundle shortly.

jane_auditor: Thanks. Can you confirm the access log retention policy and provide KMS rotation evidence for keys that encrypted logs between 2024-11-01 and 2024-11-07? Also need repro steps to reproduce the 503 behavior and a short timeline of detection/mitigation.

priya: Confirming defaults: access logs are retained 13 months. We can export sampled logs and provide chain-of-custody + manifests. Do you need PII redaction proof or a redacted copy is sufficient?

mike: Repro context: spike looked like autoscaler cooldown + burst of long requests that exhausted token memory on a few dedicated workers. I'll run a controlled repro in staging and capture traces. Quick repro script below — runs many concurrent generation requests.

mike: ```bash
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.cloud/v1/generate 
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' 
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
    -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"repeat this to create load","max_tokens":512}' &
done
wait
```

mike: Run this from staging in the us-west1 cluster, monitor /metrics and tail the runtime logs. Add a 100ms sleep between batches to mimic customer traffic.

kms_bot: KMS rotation record: rotation-id kms-rot-20241020-7b9f; rotated 2024-10-20 03:12 UTC. Manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/kms/rotation-20241020.json. HSM chain-of-custody pdf attached to bundle.

priya: Uploaded evidence bundle: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2024-11-07/incident_bundle_20241107.tar.gz (contains access log samples, sha256 manifests, incident timeline, and HSM/COK manifests). Also added a minimal redacted logs set. Sampling method described in the README inside the tar.gz. @jane_auditor

jane_auditor: Received the bundle, thanks. Please confirm the hashing algorithm used for exported logs and the exact sampling method (how files were chosen). Also need: when the issue was first detected, what mitigation steps were taken, and when service was considered restored.

sam: Detection: 2024-11-07 15:20 UTC via alerting. Mitigation: scaled dedicated pool + rolled back a runtime kernel change at 15:40 UTC. Service restored/steady at ~15:55 UTC. I've added a one-paragraph incident summary to the bundle.

priya: Hashing: SHA256 over gzipped files. Sampling: systematic sampling — every 10th rotated log file across the window 2024-11-01..2024-11-07; details + selection manifest in s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2024-11-07/sampling_manifest.csv. Verification script: `sha256sum file.gz` included in /tools.

jane_auditor: :thumbsup: This is helpful. We'll validate the artifacts and follow up if anything is missing. If possible, please also include a small snippet of the request IDs (redacted) that map to the 503s so we can cross-check traces.

mike: Will add a request-id list (redacted) and upload to the same bundle within the hour.
